description: Judge prompt-file versions that a landed run's judge of record used and that are no longer the checkout's, archived byte for byte so mode rejudge's historical instrument (scripts/petri_audit/historical.py) can rebuild that judge's prompts exactly without git history. Each file beside this index is the git blob the entry names, unchanged; historical.load_archive refuses the archive unless every file digests to its sha256 and its git_blob and canonicalises to its prompt_file_digest. Entries are added with historical.recover_from_git (git log --all over the prompt file, every version hashed; the commit is the earliest that holds the version). Never edit an archived file: a different version is a new entry.
